articles.description: Shiprocket’s IPO was subscribed 99.31 times, led by strong institutional demand, with QIBs subscribing 122.8 times. The Rs 1,617.59 crore issue also commands a 38% grey market premium over the upper price band of Rs 97. Analysts have recommended subscribing, citing the company’s growth prospects, scalable model and e-commerce opportunity.

articles.title: As citizens of Independent India, we must fulfil our basic duties even as we guard fundamental rights
articles.description: India’s 80th Independence Day is an occasion for both celebration and reflection. Let’s take a moment to reflect on why fundamental rights and responsibilities—as laid out by the Constitution—must always go hand-in-hand.

articles.title: Elon Musk discloses 48.4% stake in SpaceX in regulatory filing
articles.description: The rockets-to-AI company went public on June 12 ‌after a record-setting ⁠IPO ⁠thatraised $85.7 billion and vaulted the company's market cap past $2 trillion. ​However, its valuation has since retreated as enthusiasm faded.

articles.title: PCB crunch, US tariffs shrink Q1 electronic component exports
articles.description: First-quarter electronic component exports shrank 16% year-on-year to $1.34 billion, while overall electronic goods exports increased 22.5%, latest data from the commerce department showed.
